name: vizier
description: Deterministic authorization checks for agent actions.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @agenda-intelligence/vizier-sdk && npm run build --workspace @agenda-intelligence/vizier-gated-deploy && npm run build --workspace @agenda-intelligence/vizier-mcp-proxy
scripts.check: npm run build --workspace @agenda-intelligence/vizier-sdk && npm run typecheck && npm run check:migrations && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.pilot:worker-deploy: npm run build --workspace @agenda-intelligence/vizier-sdk && vitest run tests/worker-version-deploy.test.ts --reporter=verbose
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --check && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/gated-deploy/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mcp-proxy/tsconfig.json --noEmit
